name: j-stack-dev
description: Top-level JStack single Lead Engineer command with schema-first Prompt Compilation and automatic Product Interface motion intelligence for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Single Lead Engineer workflow, no subagents by default
interface.longDescription: Top-level Codex command for the standard JStack development workflow. One Lead Engineer first resolves material context through an inspect-first, three-question maximum gate, then applies Think, Plan, Build, Review, Test, Ship with task-specific capability methods, launch assurance, and validated evidence, without deploying subagents by default. User-facing interface work automatically uses the original Product Interface design skill and its frequency-aware, reduced-motion-aware motion specification while explicit instructions and existing project design systems keep precedence.
defaultPrompt: Run the JStack single Lead Engineer workflow.
